rationales.scope_balance: The scope covers interpretation, sequencing, and safety effectively. However, integrating all three complex outputs into a single cohesive assessment within the short time frame slightly limits the depth of the safety analysis[cite: 43].
rationales.workload_time_realism: There is meaningful time pressure. Extracting activities from a drawing, sequencing them, and deriving safety protocols within 60 minutes will require the provided drawing fixture to be extremely simplistic to be workable[cite: 43].
rationales.domain_appropriateness: The pedagogy perfectly matches construction engineering by linking drawing interpretation directly to method sequencing, and making safety explicitly traceable to site documents and procedures[cite: 43].

special_question.rationale: The design excellently maps the physical reality of construction operations—reading plans, sequencing work, and ensuring safety—into a highly coherent and domain-authentic learning path.
